EXP_FAC_RES_C_18: I delete a number of geological data packets, but the system remains offline
EXP_FAC_DESC_19: Wild energy fluctuations have brought research operations to a standstill. When I touch the terminal to investigate, a residual electric charge earths itself through my Exosuit.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_19: Alert! Electronic terminal operator power discharge! Reset primary interface!
EXP_FAC_DESC_19A: Readouts on the terminal indicate the power fluctuations are getting stronger and wilder. It will not be long before they bring down the entire facility.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_19: I attempt to stabilise the flow of power throughout the facility, but the fluctuations continue. The terminal begins to short out, then dramatically shuts down completely.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_19: I reset the primary interface. One by one, systems come back online. The power fluctuations cease.
EXP_FAC_DESC_20: Systems are super-charged despite the security alert. Equipment beneath my feet buzzes and whirrs with a high intensity. The terminal blinks a warning.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_20: Danger! Excess power! Decrease energy use immediately! Delivery at maximum!
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_DUSTY: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_LUSH: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_TOX: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_RAD: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_HOT: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_COLD: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_20: I reduce power delivery across the board. The installation returns to acceptable activity levels.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_20: I turn up the cooling systems.<DELAY>0.5<> The added strain on power delivery leads to a small internal fire. The terminal shuts down.
EXP_FAC_DESC_21: I approach the terminal. It flashes the expected security alert, but alongside is a warning I have not seen before.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_21: Unexpected biological blockage detected. Power delivery network disruption!
EXP_FAC_DESC_21A: A video feed shows a small creature is scrambling through the wiring below me, woken by the security alert. Its choice of nesting location was unwise...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_21: I boost power to the wiring loom.<DELAY>0.5<> A smell of roasted meat wafts up from the systems below. The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_21: I send a surge of highly acidic cleaning fluid through the pipes. <DELAY>0.5<> The creature is swept away. I hear a faint hiss as it bubbles away to nothingness. The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_21: I wait. Driven by the alarms, the creature struggles desperately for the exit. Eventually, it breaks free.<DELAY>0.4<> The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_22: The alarm has triggered the instant incineration of the elements used here. The process they were being used for, however, is still online.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_22: Databank back-up process stalled. Raw metal required to finish process.
EXP_FAC_DESC_22A: My scanner is picking up traces of metal, leftovers from the previous production process.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_22: I feed the metal back into the facility's supply hopper. Production comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_22:
The facility takes in my element, before the resource vaults judder and spark.

The system becomes non-operational.
WAR_FAC_DESC_1: The alarm has locked the terminal. A message displays itself letter-by-letter on the screen.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_1: Suspicious interloper visual detection system initiated!
WAR_FAC_DESC_1A: The alarm shows no sign of stopping. I notice wall-mounted security scanners slowly turn towards me...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_1:
I apply a rapid burst from my Multi-Tool directly to the facility's security cameras.
This is a partial success: my image is not captured by the system, but backup sensors react to the destruction by shutting the facility down entirely.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_1: I apply an override circuit to the security relay.<DELAY>0.5<> Remarkably, my ad-hoc wiring seems to work. The alarm stops, and the terminal grants me full access.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_1: I snap the input wires that lead from the security system to the master control terminal.<DELAY>0.5<> Remarkably, this seems to work. The alarm stops, and the error seems to reset the terminal.
WAR_FAC_DESC_2: I approach the terminal and search for a way to override the alarm. I find a likely looking button and press it, causing the terminal to respond.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_2: Grah! Vy'keen voice security scan initializing...
WAR_FAC_DESC_2A: A flap flicks open and a microphone emerges. A distant voice shouts 'Grah!'.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_2: I bark aggressively at the terminal. This appears to satisfy whatever demand was being made of me. Access is granted.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_2: I attempt to explain, but my hesitant speech instantly marks me out as an interloper. The security system delivers a high-voltage shock to my Exosuit before shutting down the terminal.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_2: I apologise, but this display of weakness instantly marks me out as an interloper. The security system delivers a high-voltage shock to my Exosuit before shutting down the terminal.
WAR_FAC_DESC_3: I approach the terminal. As the alarm blares, a laser scan refracts through my visor, then another traces the air around my breathing exhaust. The terminal flashes a warning.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_3: Intruder detected! Respiration gas concentration high! Enemy respiration!!
WAR_FAC_DESC_3A: From what I can determine, it seems my breathing patterns may be giving me away as an interloper...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_3: I hold my breath.<DELAY>0.5<> An age seems to pass.<DELAY>0.4<> Finally, moments before I lose consciousness, the terminal flashes a green light. I have been accepted as a Vy'keen.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_3: I breathe as aggressively as I can, channelling my anger at the gas sensor.<DELAY>0.3<> It has no effect. The terminal registers my failure and shuts down.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_3:
I inhale deeply before stabbing myself with the dagger.<DELAY>0.5<>. I feel so alive; shot through with adrenaline; blood pumping hard through my veins; sparks crackling down my nerves. It is glorious. Grah! Grah!
The terminal accepts me as one of the Vy'keen and allows me access.
WAR_FAC_DESC_4: The terminal flashes two alerts, presumably the source of the alarms currently ringing in my ears.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_4: Major security alert! Interloper detected! Minor alert: war factory entrance door destroyed.
WAR_FAC_DESC_4A: After printing out its status update, the terminal presents the option to override either alert. From the holographic display, the warnings appear to relate to damaged components within the facility, and the presence of an interloper.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_4: The terminal initiates an emergency shutdown.
WAR_FAC_DESC_5: I approach the terminal, searching for a way to shut off the alarm. As I stand by the input device, the floor shifts beneath my feet.<DELAY>0.4<> I hear a click.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_5: Vy'keen security system alert! Pressure pad enemy detection confirmed! Too light! Too puny!
WAR_FAC_DESC_5A: The screen has locked itself. It appears the facility is aware I am not the lifeform that usually operates here.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_5:
I pick up a large piece of scrap metal from the floor, presumably deposited there when I blew up the door.
This has the desired effect: my weight has been increased to within the non-suspicious range for a Vy'keen warrior. The terminal grants me access.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_5: I set aside my Multi-Tool, as well as other heavy items from my Exosuit's storage. The floor scales register a further series of clicks before the security system shuts me out entirely.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_5: My rapid jumps appear to confuse whatever security device is embedded in the floor. Eventually, it either overloads or is convinced by my aggression that I am a true Vy'keen. I am granted full access to the facility.
WAR_FAC_DESC_6: My presence has triggered a security alert. I hear elements being drawn from the vaults below me. On-screen: a clear countdown.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_6: Intruder alert! Commence detonation sequence! Organic fuel flow initiated!
WAR_FAC_DESC_6A: I can hear pressurised fluids filling the pipes surrounding the terminal. The sound is rather ominous, especially when combined with the high-intensity alarms...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_6:
I clamp the fuel lines. There is a brief moment of tension as pressure builds in the pipes.
It stabilises. The countdown ends, and nothing happens.<DELAY>0.4<> With some sort of disaster presumably averted, the terminal unlocks and grants me access.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_6: I clamp the catalyst flow.<DELAY>0.8<> A minor explosion scorches my arm, before facility operations resume.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_6: A blast of flame coats me from below.<DELAY>1<> The facility remains non-operational.
WAR_FAC_DESC_7: Automated security procedures are incinerating the contents of all the vaults in the facility. The terminal displays the manifest:
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_7: Intruder alert! Incinerating trading vault: imminent. Incinerating power vault: imminent. Incinerating storage vault: imminent.
WAR_FAC_DESC_7A: Power surges are igniting the vaults one-by-one. However, the terminal appears to allow for limited emergency retrievals...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_7: I activate the emergency vault retrieval system. The drone just has time to extract the contents of the trade vault before all goods are incinerated.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_7: I activate the emergency vault retrieval system. The drone just has time to extract the contents of the relic vault before all goods are incinerated.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_7: I activate the emergency vault retrieval system. The drone just has time to extract the contents of the technology vault before all goods are incinerated.
WAR_FAC_DESC_8: A transmission is firing on emergency frequencies. The terminal shows a response code from a nearby Vy'keen capital ship.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_8: Security breach! Military action unstoppable! Vy'keen High Command vessel coordinate upload imminent!
WAR_FAC_DESC_8A: It seems to be responding to my intrusion. From the images on screen, it seems to be preparing its weapon systems...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_8: I transmit the safety override code, putting an end to the emergency transmission. The Vy'keen warship stands down, broadcasting a respectful 'Grah'. The terminal unlocks.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_8: I attach a bypass circuit, allowing me to transmit the safety override code and put an end to the emergency transmission. The Vy'keen warship stands down, broadcasting a respectful 'Grah'. The terminal unlocks.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_8: I attempt to scramble the facility's coordinates, hoping to throw off the incoming fire. <DELAY>0.4<>I hear a distant explosion and the screams of burning animals. The facility's processes return to normal.
WAR_FAC_DESC_9: As I turn on the terminal, a forward-facing security scanner clicks and whirrs into focus. My bright red image is on-screen.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_9: Interloper detection! Heat detection systems confirm report! High temperature intruder!
WAR_FAC_DESC_9A: The terminal allows me no further access. In the camera feed, blue lines cross the red of my body, matching exactly to my Exosuit's coolant mesh...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_9:
I manually override my Exosuit's coolant flow. Slowly but surely a deep chill spreads across my body. My bones ache. My blood feels like ice, stabbing against every fibre of my being.
The image on the terminal screen fades from a dramatic red to a total black. I am invisible. The security alert ends, and the terminal comes back online.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_9:
I manually override my Exosuit's coolant flow. Slowly but surely I feel a burning sensation spread across my body. I begin to sweat.
The image on the terminal screen blooms a dramatic red. The security scan completes, and locks me out from the terminal entirely.
WAR_FAC_DESC_12: The terminal indicates that this facility was not an automated one. The lifeform stationed here appears to have fled.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_12: Pathetic warrior learn Vy'keen language! Pass test or encounter fighting pits! ERROR ERROR INSERT CATALYST ERROR ERROR MALFUNCTION
WAR_FAC_DESC_12A: It seems they left in the middle of some sort of exam. Perhaps I could complete their training for them...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_12:
The terminal rejects my input. It barks aggressively at me, and then closes down. It seems I have failed the test.
I hope the lifeform who was supposed to complete it does not suffer any repercussions.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_12: The comprehension test has been failed.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_12: The terminal accepts my input. It barks aggressively at me, but does go on to grant full systems access. It seems I have passed the test. Perhaps the lifeform whose place I took will be grateful.
WAR_FAC_DESC_13: A strange air hangs over the facility. Beyond the noise of the alarm, I cannot escape the feeling that something more sinister is at work. I search the terminal for clues.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_13: Grah! Initiate sentinel blood processing! Vaults full! Grah! Glass and blood! Glass and blood!
WAR_FAC_DESC_13A: The text seems to float from the screen, aggressive; it seems like no facility AI I have ever encountered. Echoing up from deep underground, I hear the electronic wail of dying Sentinels...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_13: Overcome with suspicion, I initiate an emergency shutdown of the facility AI. The alarms fall silent. The sinister electronic wail ceases. Unfortunately, the terminal has become unresponsive.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_13:
I insert a supply of pugneum into the input hopper. Machinery jumps into life. The electronic wail becomes louder still. A moment passes.
The sinister activity ends as strangely as it begun. The terminal returns to the familiar dull text of a facility control panel.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_13:
Overcome with suspicion, I initiate an emergency incineration of the facility's storage vaults. The sinister electronic wail grows louder, sharper, as the fires begin their work. Then, suddenly, silence.
The strange atmosphere of the facility fades away. The terminal returns to the familiar dull text of a master control panel.
WAR_FAC_DESC_16:
The alarm hasn't disrupted the factory's production line. I hear the strain of heavy machinery beneath my feet; the crash and boom of industry in action.
However, the terminal tells a less mighty tale. Something is wrong.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_16: Grah! Gek war preparation disrupted! Ammunition production stalled! Metal required!
WAR_FAC_DESC_16A: The vaults seem to be empty. The machines clatter angrily, but produce nothing.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_16: I fill the input hopper with a fresh supply of ferrite. The machines continue to chatter, but now do so smoothly, their supply lines well-fed.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_16: I fill the input hopper with a fresh supply of di-hydrogen. An explosion echos up from the machinery below. The highly reactive substance has caused some sort of industrial calamity.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_16: I fill the input hopper with a fresh supply of sodium. An explosion echos up from the machinery below. The highly reactive substance has caused some sort of industrial calamity.
WAR_FAC_DESC_17: The facility is full of blaring noise, an angry warning against my intrusion. The terminal shows a similarly angry message, apparently upset at the hitch in production.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_17: High Command demand explanation! Scare element required! Demand chromatic metal! Restore contributions!
WAR_FAC_DESC_17A: It appears an off-world overseer is making demands. If I satisfy them, perhaps I'll be granted full access to the terminal...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_17: The terminal relays an apologetic bark. The demand is waived. Full access is granted to the facility's control panel.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_17: The terminal relays a confused and angry bark. The remote overseer shuts the terminal down completely, upset by my paltry contribution.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_17: The terminal relays a resonant bark, the response of a happy warrior. With their demand satisfied, full access is restored to the facility's control panel.
WAR_FAC_DESC_20: The terminal flashes an urgent warning. Some vital part of the facility has been compromised by the security alert.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_20: Intruder alert! Battle enzyme production halted! Electrical charge removed from body harvest circuit!
WAR_FAC_DESC_20A: The display takes me aback.<DELAY>0.4<> A warrior's heart is on-screen, its beat irregular.<DELAY>0.3<> Connected to wires and artificial valves, it seems to pump a biological liquid through organs deep within the facility.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_20:
I increase the power flow to the facility's heart. It judders, then establishes a regular beat. Its strange existence continues.
With this emergency over, the terminal reverts to a standard factory input system.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_20:
I initiate a surge of adrenalin directly into the facility's heart. It judders, tenses, tenses again... and with a final convulsion, falls still.
The terminal screen cuts out. There is nothing to see but an inky blackness.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_20:
I power down the facility in an attempt to ease the strain on its heart. But as systems shut down, the heart begins to slow. Before I can reverse the process, it beats its last.
The mass of organs that relied on its processes are starved of oxygen, and die. The terminal screen cuts out. There is nothing to see but an inky blackness.
WAR_FAC_DESC_19: I approach the terminal, but a secondary security sweep is already underway.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_19: Security scan initializing! Motion detection cameras operational! Security scan initializing!
WAR_FAC_DESC_19A: Scanners emerge from the ceiling and start to pan towards where I stand. Detection feels like it would not lead to optimal outcomes.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_19: I attempt to hide. However, it is too late. The scanners detect me as I try to duck down. This second security alert causes the entire facility to shut down.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_19:
I stand perfectly still as the scanners sweep over me, their electronic eyes unblinking. Eventually, they pass.
With their checks concluded, the security alert comes to an end. The terminal unlocks.
ALL_FAC_SUCCESS_RES: The facility's workflow is successfully restored. The alarms cease, and the terminal grants me full access to its fabrication modules.
ALL_FAC_FAIL_RES: The terminal rejects the input and shuts down entirely. A small red light flashes on the display, tracking my movements.
TRA_FAC_DESC_18: The security alert is scrambling the screen. All that is visible is a chaotic jumble of alien words.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_18: // TRADE // ORBITAL // DOCKING // TRADE // ORBITAL // DOCKING //
TRA_FAC_DESC_18A: This appears to be an AI-driven facility. If I were to reactivate the correct workflow, its autonomous systems may bring the installation back online...
TRA_FAC_DESC_19: This autonomous manufacturing facility has been scrambled by the alarm. The terminal is mostly unreadable static, with only a handful of legible words...
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_19: // FLIGHT // INTERSTELLAR // STARSHIP // FLIGHT // INTERSTELLAR // STARSHIP //
TRA_FAC_DESC_19A: There's hopefully enough to make sense of what the last user was working on, which could restore systems...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_19:
The previous user's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_19:
I fail to access the previous user's workflow.

The installation remains offline.
TRA_FAC_DESC_20: The security breach has dimmed the terminal, but when I concentrate I can make out a few words etched onto the screen...
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_20: // WEAPON // BEAM // MINING // WEAPON // BEAM // MINING //
TRA_FAC_DESC_20A: When translated they could lead me to the last user's workflow, which would automatically bring the facility back online...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_20:
The previous user's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_20:
I fail to access the previous user's workflow.

The installation remains offline.
TRA_FAC_DESC_21: The security breach has scrambled the screen, but some text is still legible.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_21: // INVISIBLE // BARRIER // DEFENSIVE // INVISIBLE // BARRIER // DEFENSIVE //
TRA_FAC_DESC_21A: The words can be traced back to the previous user's workflow, which is how I can get it back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_21:
The previous user's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
